scope: D3D8/9 standalone and implicit surface private data and additional-chain back-buffer storage lifetime. Wine private-data Windows tests and surface lifetime implementations provide primary reference facts. XP tests our replacement DLLs; full Reset, COM surface identity and D3D8 additional-chain pixel independence remain separate review work.

facts.queryWithoutOutput: D3D_OK; reports required size without AddRef, even if supplied capacity is small
facts.smallOutput: D3DERR_MOREDATA; size updated, output and refs unchanged
facts.missing: D3DERR_NOTFOUND; outputs unchanged, NULL size allowed
facts.successfulGet: returns copied bytes or retained interface pointer
facts.parentChild: Independent stores; same GUID does not inherit across parent, sibling mip or cube face
facts.viewLifetime: Store belongs to logical level, survives releasing/reacquiring a view and ends with parent
facts.surfaceStorage: Standalone surface storage ends at destruction; implicit back-buffer/depth storage survives public Release/Get while its owner survives.
facts.chainStorage: Back-buffer private storage remains alive with surface views after the chain COM reference reaches zero; separate chains/devices have separate GUID domains.
